cases.note: status_key — exactly what O3 (responder R) receives as a query
effect receipt (in-memory log record) fields; not a wire object
root (OrganizationRoot) signed payload fields — raw bundle data; the verifier ignores the slot but a holder and P see its bytes
MediationRequest P receives — an in-memory request struct (its `bundle` field carries the raw bundle bytes), not a wire object
O1 bundle holder (e.g. tester / anyone shown a grant): the four bundle slots, including the ignored-but-visible root
O2 provider P: the bundle (incl. root), the R-signed status response, the session exchange, and the mediation request it receives
O3 responder R: only the StatusKey query; the model assumes R never gets P's now/ε
O5 log/effect-sink reader: the effect receipts
